subject.title: feat(agents): per-agent outbound A2A allowlist override

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this outbound-only per-agent A2A allowlist contract now, or keep it closed until the broader session-authorization model is chosen?
rationale: The patch is plausible and proven, but it creates public config and SDK authorization semantics that overlap active product/security design questions.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this branch for conservative cleanup and invite a maintainer-sponsored replacement or reopening once the session authorization model is settled.

options.title: Sponsor outbound-only A2A
options.body: A maintainer explicitly accepts requester-owned outbound-only semantics, then the contributor resolves conflicts and refreshes validation.

options.title: Fold into broader design
options.body: Use the canonical per-agent/session authorization issue to choose one config model before landing any partial PR.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this branch for conservative cleanup and invite a maintainer-sponsored replacement or reopening once the session authorization model is settled.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest feature-history signal on the session-tool security boundary and is the best available owner for the product/security direction choice.
